description: Pages on a SUSTAINED camera fault only, four tiers: DOWN (a camera offline) 8 min; SLOW/FROZEN (degraded, still serving frames) 30 min - transient stream blips self-recover well inside that window; FLEET-STALE (multiple cameras byte-identical to their previous probe) 5 min; and FLEET-MISS (multiple probes failing in a single cycle) 5 min - added after a whole-fleet blackout during a brief network outage was absorbed by the per-camera miss tolerance and published as 'all OK'.

data.title: ⚠️ Camera issue
data.message:
{{ state_attr('sensor.camera_health','summary') }}

{% if trigger.id == 'fleet_frozen' %}{{ state_attr('sensor.camera_health','stale_count') }} of 9 cameras have returned byte-identical frames for 5+ min - the snapshot pipeline is serving stale frames fleet-wide (Scrypted stream wedge or Ring cloud outage). Live view and HKSV are likely affected. Usual fix: reload the Ring plugin in Scrypted; if snapshots stay stale, restart the Scrypted add-on.{% elif trigger.id == 'fleet_miss' %}{{ state_attr('sensor.camera_health','miss_count') }} camera probes failed in the same cycle - a fleet-level outage (network, engine, or host), not a single camera.{% else %}Sustained {{ trigger.id }} fault.{% endif %} {{ now().strftime('%b %-d %-I:%M %p') }}.
